title: Sell Mineral Rights in Bellaire, MI
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Bellaire, MI
metaDescription: Bellaire, MI is the Antrim County seat and the record-keeping hub for local mineral rights. Get an honest evaluation of your Antrim Shale interest.
heroLead: Bellaire is the county seat of Antrim County, which means it's also where the paper trail lives for just about every mineral interest tied to this part of the Antrim Shale core.
intro: As the county seat, Bellaire is home to the Antrim County register of deeds, the office holding the recorded chain of title for mineral interests across the county, including whatever land your family's interest is tied to. Bellaire itself sits along the Intermediate River near Lake Bellaire, in the Antrim Shale drilling area, and the town's economy has shifted over the decades from farming and small industry to tourism tied to the Chain of Lakes.

sections.heading: Why Bellaire is where you start, not necessarily where your interest sits
paragraphs: If you're trying to figure out what mineral interest you hold anywhere in Antrim County, Bellaire's register of deeds is the place to pull deeds, probate records, and recorded leases. That's true whether the actual land tied to your interest is in Bellaire itself, out toward Mancelona, or up near Central Lake or Ellsworth. A lot of owners assume their paperwork has to match where they currently live, but mineral ownership follows the land, not the family's current address.

Bellaire and the surrounding townships have real Antrim Shale production history from the late 1980s and 1990s boom, so an interest tied to land in or near town is very plausibly connected to a mature, long-producing well.

sections.heading: What a Bellaire-area interest is worth today
paragraphs: Same honest story as the rest of Antrim County: wells from the boom years are decades into a long, flat decline now, and royalty checks reflect that. We look at your actual statements and current production for your specific section before putting a number on anything, and we'll tell you straight if a modest lump sum or continuing to hold makes more sense for your situation.

faqs.question: Is the Antrim County register of deeds located in Bellaire?
faqs.answer: Yes, Bellaire is the Antrim County seat and holds the recorded deeds, probate records, and leases for mineral interests across the county.

faqs.question: Does my mineral interest have to be located in Bellaire itself to be tied to Antrim County records?
faqs.answer: No, the register of deeds in Bellaire covers the whole county, so land near Mancelona, Central Lake, or anywhere else in Antrim County has its recorded title history there too.

faqs.question: How mature is typical Antrim Shale production around Bellaire?
faqs.answer: Most wells here were drilled during the 1986 to 1998 boom and are now decades into a long, flat production decline, meaning smaller volumes and smaller royalty checks than in the early years.

faqs.question: What should I bring to start evaluating my Bellaire-area mineral interest?
faqs.answer: Your deed or probate document, any royalty statements or division orders, and the legal description if you have it. We'll take it from there.
